    n = int(data[0])

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    a = sorted(int(x) for x in data[2:2 + n])
    m = n - k
    best = None
    for i in range(n - m + 1):
        d = a[i + m - 1] - a[i]
        if best is None or d < best:
            best = d
    print(best)
